subject.title: fix(core): harden CLI lifecycle and suite isolation

question: Should strict manifests intentionally reject existing fixture retry counts above 10, or must this PR preserve the retry range accepted by current releases?
rationale: The code can implement either contract, but tests cannot establish whether invalidating previously valid manifests is approved upgrade policy.

options.title: Preserve Compatibility
options.body: Retain the previously accepted retry range while applying only a runtime-safe bound that does not invalidate existing manifests.

options.title: Approve Hard Cap
options.body: Keep the limit of 10 and add explicit upgrade documentation plus fresh-install and upgrade proof showing the intended failure mode.

options.title: Split Retry Validation
options.body: Land the independent lifecycle and isolation fixes while deferring the retry contract to a separately reviewed change.

recommendation.title: Preserve Compatibility
recommendation.body: Retain the previously accepted retry range while applying only a runtime-safe bound that does not invalidate existing manifests.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository's initial schema, provider, and setup-documentation foundations trace most directly to steipete's merged history.
